salotto.title: Living Room
salotto.desc: A bright living room with Smart TV, comfortable sofa, and a mini Roman bookshelf. Natural light and direct garden views create a warm, relaxing atmosphere — the perfect retreat after a day exploring the monuments.

cucina.title: Kitchen / Dining Area
cucina.desc: Fully equipped kitchen with gas stove, electric oven, microwave, moka pot, and automatic coffee machine. Dishwasher and dining area for peaceful breakfasts and intimate dinners — everything you need to feel at home.

camera1.title: Master Bedroom
camera1.desc: The master bedroom is designed for peaceful, comfortable rest. A premium double bed with quality linens and carefully curated details make this room the perfect retreat after a day in Rome.

camera2.title: Second Bedroom
camera2.desc: A cozy second bedroom with a small double bed (French size), ideal for guests, family members, or children. Welcoming and functional, with the same attention to comfort and quality as the master bedroom.

bagno.title: Bathroom
bagno.desc: Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and washing machine. Well-organized space with curated finishes for everyday practical comfort, designed for stays of any length.

giardino.title: Private Garden
giardino.desc: Private garden ideal for outdoor breakfast, evening relaxation and quiet moments in the heart of Rome. The lush vegetation and intimate atmosphere make it perfect for a sunset aperitivo or an afternoon read.

dettagli.title: Details
dettagli.desc: The small details that make your stay unique: a framed Rome print, a mini editorial bookshelf, and Italian design touches that transform every corner into a visual experience.

esterno.title: Exterior
esterno.desc: Elegant house facade with private entrance, staircase and potted plants. A warm welcome to your private Roman hideaway.

reviews.title: What Our Guests Say
reviews.subtitle: Authentic stories from travelers who chose San Paolo Hideout

review1.name: Sophie & Marc
review1.text: A perfect retreat in Rome. The garden is an oasis of peace after intense days among monuments. The proximity to the Metro allowed us to explore everything without stress. We will definitely return.

review2.name: Thomas K.
review2.text: Excellent location for work at EUR and evening life in Ostiense. The self check-in was perfect for my late arrival. Fast Wi-Fi and quiet space for remote work. Highly recommended.

review3.name: Rossi Family
review3.text: With two children, having a private garden in Rome is priceless. The detached house is spacious, spotlessly clean, and with everything needed. The kids loved playing in the garden. Metro at 3 minutes is fantastic.

review4.name: Emma L.
review4.text: I stayed for a month as a visiting professor at Roma Tre. The location was perfect — only 300 meters from campus! The host was always available. The garden was my favorite place to read in the evening.

review5.name: Yuki & Kenji
review5.text: Roman holidays made perfect! The detached house is beautiful, clean and very well equipped. The private garden is like a dream. Metro connection made everything accessible. Our best stay in Europe.

review6.name: Ana María V.
review6.text: The private garden is absolutely magical. The house is even more beautiful than in the photos. Communication with the host was impeccable. Definitely the best accommodation we've had in Rome.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay

q1.question: How does check-in work?
q1.answer: We offer 24/7 self check-in with digital code. You'll receive detailed instructions via WhatsApp the day before arrival. For arrivals after 10 PM, autonomous check-in is always available.

q2.question: How far is the Metro station?
q2.answer: Basilica San Paolo Metro B station is just a 3-minute walk away. From there you can reach the Colosseum in 4 stops, Termini in 6 stops, and EUR in 7 minutes.

q3.question: Is parking available?
q3.answer: Yes, there are paid parking lots nearby. Free parking available on side streets. We can also arrange private parking with advance notice.

q4.question: How do I get from the airport?
q4.answer: From Fiumicino Airport, take the regional train to Roma Ostiense (20-25 min), then 2 Metro B stops to Basilica San Paolo. Alternatively, taxi for approximately €45.

q5.question: Is it suitable for families with children?
q5.answer: Absolutely! The detached house with private garden is perfect for children. We have a highchair and travel cot available on request. The house is spacious and safe for little ones.

q6.question: Can I work from here?
q6.answer: Of course! Fast fiber Wi-Fi, quiet environment, and a detached house. Ideal for remote work, visiting professors, or business trips to EUR.

q7.question: What is the house layout?
q7.answer: San Paolo Hideout is a detached house with: living room with Smart TV and sofa, fully equipped kitchen with dining area, master bedroom with double bed, second bedroom with small double bed, bathroom with shower and washing machine, and private garden. Perfect for 4 guests.
